title: Dynamic Adaptation of the LLM Context for Generating Routines with Coupled Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2609.04570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based code generation fails when correctness depends on execution-dependent coupling: the meaning of one routine is defined by the runtime behavior of another, a relationship that cannot be resolved from textual descriptions alone. This limitation, which we call static binding, is not confined to explicitly coupled problems; it appears to varying degrees whenever correctness depends on joint execution behavior across components, from explicit cross-coupled optimizers to subtler joint constraints in packing, routing, and symbolic search. This paper proposes dynamic context adaptation, a sample-efficient validation-generation loop designed for this setting. A validation agent extracts structured diagnostic information from execution traces, providing gradient-like guidance to a generation agent that proposes multiple candidates per iteration. translated_title: 面向耦合语义例程生成的LLM上下文动态自适应
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的代码生成在正确性依赖于执行相关耦合时会失败：一个例程的含义由另一个例程的运行时行为所定义，而这种关系无法仅从文本描述中解析出来。我们将这一限制称为“静态绑定”，它并不仅限于显式耦合的问题；只要正确性依赖于组件间的联合执行行为，它就会不同程度地出现，从显式的交叉耦合优化器到打包、路由和符号搜索中更微妙的联合约束均是如此。本文提出了动态上下文自适应方法，这是一种为该场景设计的样本高效的“验证-生成”循环。一个验证代理从执行轨迹中提取结构化的诊断信息，为生成代理提供类似梯度的引导，生成代理在每次迭代中提出多个候选方案。由问题描述导出的知识图谱为其提供语义约束。
tldr: 提出一种动态上下文自适应方法，通过验证代理与生成代理组成的样本高效迭代循环以及知识图谱语义约束，解决LLM代码生成中因例程间执行耦合（静态绑定）导致的正确性问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes dynamic context adaptation, a sample-efficient validation-generation loop with knowledge-graph semantic constraints, to overcome the "static binding" limitation of LLM code generation when correctness depends on execution-coupled routines.
